recipes.title: Birria de Res
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site. It shows a long cook, three photos and ingredient sections.
steps: Toast the chiles in a dry pan until fragrant, then soak them in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend the chiles with the garlic, cumin, vinegar and a little soaking water until smooth.
Season the beef with salt and brown it in a heavy pot.
Add the sauce, bay leaves and broth. Cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart, about 3 hours.
Let it rest, skim the fat and shred the meat. Serve in bowls or in tacos with the broth.

recipes.title: Arroz con Gandules
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site.
steps: Heat the oil in a caldero and cook the sofrito for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice until coated, then add the pigeon peas, olives, salt and broth.
Bring to a boil, cover tightly and cook on low until the rice is tender, about 25 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve.
photos: arroz.jpg
Arroz con gandules in a well-used caldero

recipes.title: Pastelón
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site. Its yield is a range, to check how that displays.
steps: Fry the plantain slices until golden, then drain them.
Brown the beef with the sofrito, then stir in the tomato sauce.
Layer plantains, beef and cheese in a baking dish, ending with plantains and cheese.
Pour the eggs over the top and bake at 350°F until set, about 30 minutes.
photos: pastelon.jpg
Pastelón baked in a clay dish

recipes.title: Chuchitos
recipes.story: Receta de ejemplo para probar el sitio. Está escrita en español para comprobar las traducciones.
steps: Mezcla la masa con la manteca y el caldo hasta que quede suave.
Coloca un poco de masa en cada hoja y agrega pollo y recado.
Envuelve y amarra cada chuchito.
Cocina al vapor durante una hora y deja reposar antes de servir.
photos: chuchitos.jpg
Chuchitos envueltos en hojas de maíz sobre un textil de colores

recipes.title: Pollo en Mole Negro
recipes.story: Receta de ejemplo para probar el sitio.
steps: Cuece el pollo en agua con sal y reserva el caldo.
Tuesta los chiles y las almendras, y remójalos en caldo caliente.
Licúa todo hasta obtener una salsa tersa.
Cocina la salsa a fuego bajo, agrega el chocolate y deja espesar.
Sirve el pollo bañado con el mole.
photos: mole.jpg
Pollo con mole negro y arroz en un plato de barro

recipes.title: Pupusas de Queso
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site. It's marked vegetarian, to check the dietary filter.
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough, then rest it for 5 minutes.
Divide into 8 balls, press a hollow in each, fill with cheese and seal.
Pat into thick discs.
Cook on a hot griddle until browned on both sides, about 4 minutes per side.
photos: pupusas.jpg
Pupusas cooking on a hot griddle with curtido on the side

recipes.title: Arepas Reina Pepiada
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site.
steps: Mix the corn flour, salt and water into a dough and rest it for 5 minutes.
Shape into 6 discs and cook on an oiled griddle until crisp on both sides.
Mash the avocado with the mayonnaise and lime, then fold in the chicken.
Split the arepas and fill them with the chicken mixture.
photos: arepas.jpg
Arepas filled with chicken and avocado on a clay tile

recipes.title: Empanadas de Carne
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site. It carries a transcription note, to check how notes display.
steps: Cook the onion until soft, add the beef and paprika, and brown.
Chill the filling, then stir in the chopped eggs.
Fill the discs, fold them over and crimp the edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 400°F until golden, about 25 minutes.
photos: empanadas.jpg
Golden empanadas on a wooden board in front of a clay oven

recipes.title: Ceviche Clásico
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site. It's flagged as adapted from a website, so it stops at the Clear the source step. The link is a placeholder.
steps: Toss the fish with the salt and ají.
Add the lime juice and leave for 10 minutes, until the fish turns opaque.
Fold in the onion.
Serve straight away with sweet potato.

Ceviche in a speckled bowl with sweet potato and corn

recipes.title: Alfajores de Maicena
recipes.story: An example recipe for testing the site.
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then add the yolks.
Fold in the flour and cornstarch, then chill the dough for an hour.
Roll out, cut rounds and bake at 350°F for 12 minutes, without browning.
Sandwich pairs with dulce de leche and dust with powdered sugar.

Alfajores dusted with powdered sugar on a white plate
